about: Hand-curated venue research for the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo, keyed by our own venue code. Not edition-specific. Every figure carries the URL it was read from; a figure nobody could cite is null, never estimated.

castle-esplanade.name: Edinburgh Castle Esplanade
castle-esplanade.notes: Open-air arena of temporary grandstands in front of the castle; seated by price band (A+ to D, Premier, Royal Gallery).
